input: Write a tribute post for my company's anniversary

gold.taskTitle: Write a Company Anniversary Tribute Post
gold.taskDescription: Write a tribute post to celebrate the user's company anniversary for publication.

questions.title: Which anniversary milestone is the company celebrating?
questions.description: Identify the specific year milestone (e.g., 1st, 5th, 10th, 25th) to set the tone and weight of the tribute.

questions.title: Where will this post be published?
questions.description: Determine the platform (LinkedIn, Instagram, company blog, internal newsletter, etc.) to guide format, length, and tone.

questions.title: Who is the primary audience reading this post?
questions.description: Clarify whether the post is directed at customers, employees, investors, the general public, or a mix.

questions.title: What tone should the post carry?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants the post to feel inspirational, heartfelt, professional, celebratory, or storytelling-driven.

questions.title: What key achievements should the post highlight?
questions.description: Gather specific milestones, numbers, products, or moments the user wants to feature prominently in the tribute.

questions.title: Should the post mention specific people or teams?
questions.description: Find out whether founders, employees, long-term clients, or partners should be named or acknowledged in the tribute.

questions.title: Is there a word count or length limit in mind?
questions.description: Determine any length constraints or preferences so the post fits the intended platform and audience attention span.
